title: BT D-Bus Resilience & Multi-Speaker Stability
implementation_notes: Expanded before implementation. In addition to D-Bus recovery, AVRCP/PipeWire sync, adapter profiling and multi-speaker codec lock, the track now removes unproven WebUI operational status claims and replaces fixed bt_soundbar/alexa_to_bt diagnostics with dynamic BlueZ/PipeWire/WirePlumber sink and route evidence. Includes explicit not-applicable/stale/error semantics and remote Playwright coverage.
